name: boca
description: Comments on any web page, carried by public Nostr relays: no server, no account, nothing to sign up for.
author: Ilka Guigova

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/main.js src/background.js --bundle --format=esm --target=chrome120 --outdir=dist && cp -r static/. dist/ && curl -fsS https://iguigova.github.io/brand.css -o dist/brand.css
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && rm -f ../boca.zip && zip -qr ../boca.zip .
